content: This case concerned the division of a multi-unit building where the spouses already occupied different sections,. The legal issue was whether the court could bypass the random draw (sorteggio) mandated by Article 729. The judge interpreted the rule flexibly, deciding that because the expert had created homogenous lots of equal value that matched the spouses' current living arrangements, direct assignment was more efficient and served the interests of both parties better than a draw.
